$comment: Managed by copilot-governance. Do not edit this file downstream.
Surface: VS Code Copilot. Deployed to .github/hooks/prompt-interceptor.json.
The hook command runs with the workspace root as its working directory, so
the path below is workspace-relative. Node accepts forward slashes on every
platform, so no per-OS command variants are needed.
--surface vscode is REQUIRED. UserPromptSubmit is sent by both VS Code and
Claude Code, and the two do not share an output schema — VS Code blocks via
exit code 2 while Claude Code blocks via a top-level decision field. Without
the flag the engine would have to guess, and a wrong guess fails open.
What this surface can actually do (verified 2026-08-02, API is Preview):
VS Code documents NO prompt-replacement field on UserPromptSubmit, so
governance is delivered as hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext beside the
developer's untouched prompt. The engine also emits modifiedPrompt on the
chance it is supported undocumented; unknown fields are ignored and nothing
depends on it landing. permissionDecision is PreToolUse-only and is ignored
here, so exit 2 is the only way to stop a prompt.
If node is unavailable the command exits non-zero, which the runtime treats
